scope: Read-only source, license, dependency, and portability audit of the original environment and independent Godot static art study. This record preserves completed findings; no Blender/Godot execution or asset download was performed during the audit.

assets.use: Authored gate, walls, buttress, and modified fallen masonry
Four fern-clump variants, instanced at edges and wall roots
Framing rocks, stones, and smaller rubble
Ground soil/gravel diffuse and normal layers
Ground grass/moss diffuse and normal layers
Localized old approach diffuse and normal layers
Instanced grass blades at selected banks
assets.credit_note: The original SOURCES.md also credits Rob Tuytel (photography). The official asset page inspected on 2026-10-07 lists only Rico Cilliers; remove the additional credit unless another primary source supports it.

assets.use: Sparse edge shrubs and wall-root foliage
Original trunk/branches plus 120000 original leaf triangles, re-instanced into two edge framing groups

direct_blend_inspection.method: Decompress Zstandard in memory, parse Blender BHead and SDNA records, inspect Image/PackedFile/ImagePackedFile references and embedded byte lengths. No Blender process, auto-execution, scene save, or rendering.
direct_blend_inspection.image_paths: All 40 Image.name path fields are //assets/... relative paths.
direct_blend_inspection.retained_metadata_paths: Packed-image metadata contains original workspace asset paths. These are provenance/path metadata, not observed external file dependencies; their exact strings are omitted here.
direct_blend_inspection.caveat: Binary structural inspection confirms the listed dependency facts, not rendering correctness, shading equivalence, performance, collision, or gameplay.

integrity.distinction: This audit independently recomputed all 77 SHA-256 entries. The 54 MD5 successes are read from the existing download audit, not a new download or independent comparison with the current API.
integrity.checksum_manifest_scope_note: The original 77-entry checksum manifest describes the larger research source set. Assets intentionally absent from a compact archive must not be reported as archive corruption; generate a separate inventory for the actual archive.

hero_png.status: AI-generated static idle direction master image; not a 3D model or animation acceptance deliverable

font.observed_issue: The original standalone Godot directory lacks the accompanying license text. Include it in the compact archive.

godot_art_study.import_settings: Keep the three asset .import settings files; both PNGs specify mipmaps/generate=true. The .godot cache is regenerable.
godot_art_study.launch: project.godot has no application/run/main_scene; document launching with --script res://preview.gd.

portability_findings.finding: Uses paths relative to __file__; needs the excluded assets/ source tree. Preserve as a construction recipe, not a runnable compact-archive rebuild claim.
Writes verification-final.json and saves/overwrites the blend with compression. It is not a read-only verifier; do not include its save behavior in a read-only entry point.

Reusable tree subset acquisition recipe, but performs network reads and output writes. Requires sources/tree_small_02-files.json and sources/tree_small_02_original.gltf.json; not needed to open or render the packed blend.

The original text says assets/ are included and the local glTF build can be run. A compact archive must explicitly distinguish rendering the packed blend from rebuilding with separately retrieved source assets.

document_secret_scan.scope: Environment root README/SOURCES, JSON audit/manifests/checksums, Python scripts, and sources/*.json
document_secret_scan.patterns: Credential field/header names, password/secret markers, signed/token-bearing URL markers, and private absolute filesystem roots. No credential values were sought or printed.
document_secret_scan.caveat: Pattern inspection is a scoped check, not a general-purpose secret-scanner guarantee.

repeatability.dependencies: Python 3; zstandard is needed only for Zstandard-compressed .blend files.
repeatability.output: JSON to stdout only; input scene is never modified.
repeatability.saved_script_status: Saved from the already successful inline inspection method; the saved entry point has not been executed in this preservation step.
